description: Upload test-coverage measurements for one or many repos (e.g. synced from SonarQube). Requires `write` scope. Each item needs repo ("owner/name") and either percent (0–100) or a raw lcov report. percent is LINE coverage: from SonarQube read the `line_coverage` measure, not `coverage`, which also counts branch conditions and so does not compare with other sources. Optionally send branch and measuredAt (the analysis date) per item: a reading for a non-default branch, or older than the stored figure, is kept as history only. Writes coverage to the matching codebase + the org repo index, so a Program Genesis quality program can scope "repos below X%". Batch up to 200 items per call — chunk larger syncs. Map SonarQube projects to owner/repo via their GitHub binding before calling; ask the operator about any you can't map.

items.description: Coverage measurements (up to 200). Use this for batch sync.

branch.description: Optional branch the measurement was taken on.

commitSha.description: Optional commit the measurement was taken at.

lcov.description: Alternative to percent: a raw lcov report; coverage is computed from it.

measuredAt.description: Optional time the measurement was taken (ISO 8601, e.g. a SonarQube analysis date).

percent.description: Line coverage % (0–100). From SonarQube: the `line_coverage` measure.

name: anyforge_upload_coverage
title: Upload coverage
